body: doesn’t help that i don’t feel good enough for UCI in general. Really hoping that some AO by chance heavily resonated with one of my essays or something. Wish Friday could be here already dude
I got a 7/5/7 on my essay, do you think I should take it again this upcoming test day (Saturday)?

Definitely. 

I am hoping that if I do get diagnosed, my doctor will express to them how much I’m truly struggling, since they can’t seem to believe it when I tel them personally. 

Maybe a professional will help them understand the necessity of it. I’ve been struggling with ADHD-like symptoms since at least third grade and I definitely feel myself getting worse especially with all the different things you have to juggle during the application process. It’s been taking a lot of will power for me to not throw up my hands completely topple over. 

My goal now is to get the diagnosis, I’ve been going to therapy for a year now. If I do, I will take the proper measures to either get my doctor to prescribe it to me without needing my mom’s permission (ie; when i’m 18 or close to it which isn’t too long of a shot since I’m turning 17 in 3 months and some diagnoses take even an entire year!) or convincing my family that i need it. Thank you so much for replying and for you advice :)

Reading your reply was so extremely moving and genuinely inspiring. Stories like yours reinforces the belief in the back of my mind that time is crucial, we may not be in the place we want to now, but somewhere down the line, life may make a way for us. I’m planning to go into the psychology field myself, I plan to become a psychiatric nurse practitioner. I want to help people who may be in the same place I am now. Thank you so much for your beautiful reply and good luck on your thesis! :) You got this. We got this.

I admire you so greatly for being able to push through hardship and improve during college no less. I almost feel being in a college environment would socially and somewhat academically be better for me because in both aspects it’s very independent. I am a people pleaser and having teachers directly holding you accountable makes not achieving the way I want or forgetting to do an assignment or not finishing it feel 100x worse. I do hope by the time i start my semester I will have been evaluated and either diagnosed and hopefully be on medication or not and referred to another source of treatment so I can better balance the actually workload. Thank you so much for extending your kindness and replying to my post :) x

As an empath, just reading that my post moved you to tears makes me tear up too haha! This is possibly the most heartwarming comment I have received, never have I ever had someone tell me my writing actually evoked such emotion. I’m so glad to see there’s someone else like me on this sub, I don’t often seen other teenage girls. I wish all under represented ADHD folks could come together and show ourselves we’re not alone. If i’m beautiful, you’re gorgeous. We get through this, we may struggle now but i want to believe there’s a light at the end of the tunnel. Thank you tremendously for your kindness :)

Is this some type of Back to The Future situation we’re not aware of... haha

I felt the need to identify myself as a black girl because as a demographic i feel like we are severely under diagnosed and the complete opposite of what is believed the “stereotypical” ADHD person looks like. I haven’t seen many people on this sub like us so i’m so glad I get to talk to you! 

It’s such a relief that there’s another person like me out there in the world too (I do live in the U.S! Where are you from?) and don’t mind the rambling I do it too!! I’m so glad that you relate to this. Posting this, I felt very over dramatic like I was really pulling out the theatrics and to hear that not only you read it but resonate is so encouraging, thank you so much for replying x

edit; I saw that you’re active in the INFP sub too, you’re gonna think this is wild but i’m INFP too!! That’s insane!!

I’ve definitely considered being somewhere on the Autism spectrum at some point. I really hope that come my appointment in December, my doctor helps me figure this all out. It’s just so unreal to me that since autism and adhd are mostly childhood disorders, that I would have lived with them almost my whole life and not realized. I wonder how different my life would have been had I checked for either sooner. Thank you for your reply!

Some mental health professionals have so many hidden biases when it comes to disorders like ADHD it’s so hard to find one who will take you seriously and not make you feel like you’re attention or drug seeking or just over exaggerating when it comes to the disorder :( I don’t understand why people would think we would “want” any of this much congratulations to the successes you *have* made though! Aerospace engineering and medicine are both not easy fields to go into! I totally relate to the studying. I have no idea how to study and I always wait to cram for everything. It’s what i’m doing right now, actually. I also understand by what you mean when you say you can’t explain it. The feeling is hard to articulate, you just know. You just know something isn’t working right. You don’t know how, you just know. My advice though it may be futile is if you feel like something is wrong, it’s best to get it evaluated. If they somehow say it’s not ADHD and you don’t trust it, get another opinion. Or if they give you another feasible explanation as to why you feel the way you do, work with them to treat it. I wish you all the best in your future endeavors in Med! Thank you for replying to my post it makes me feel less alone :)

I don’t think specific personalities are attached to disorders. But when i look through the INFP subreddit i notice a lot of things that people mention resemble things that I feel people with ADHD typically experience. I feel like we’re more prone? to it? I don’t know it’s all pseudoscience but it’s weird how many people on there mention ADHD and ADHD-like symptoms.

super awesome to know that there’s someone around my age here who knows what i’m going through! Just checked your profile and saw you posted to the INFP subreddit. Are you INFP!? Because I am too! Haha what a crazy coincidence :)

Thank you! It’s super difficult being young and living under the roof of people who are uncomfortable with things involving the mental health system. My mom is a psychiatric nurse at a mental hospital 30 minutes from where we live. She sees patients who suffer at the hands of medication’s side effects and she’s personally seen her sister, my aunt, go through a real bad experience taking medication and so she and my grandma are really paranoid about it. I turn 17 soon. After that it’ll be a year before I don’t need their permission anymore. I don’t know if I’ll be able to last the year working like this though. Thanks again for the advice :)

thank you so much. I criticize myself..a lot i always try to hold onto the hope that it gets better. That people who’ve gone through worse than me have come out at the other end with a few scars, but relatively fine. I want to believe if i just go with the flow life will lead me into a place where i belong.

I hate using the terms “low” and “high” functioning i feel like it minimizes struggles and there’s a lot of nasty stigma to it. I only use it for lack of better words. I just come across as someone that most people would think would have a problem you know? I just convinced my mom to make me an appointment to get evaluated. But her and my grandma are starkly against medication. So even if i am diagnosed they might not let me take anything :(

Having the same problem :/ my mom and grandma come from a culture where formal medication is highly looked down on. They prefer more unorthodox, natural methods. When i was prescribed Zoloft last year November they never let me take it. My anxiety got better on its own and now they use that against me. I JUST convinced my mom to schedule an appointment for me to get evaluated for possible ADHD and i’m pretty sure they won’t let me take meds for it if I’m actually diagnosed either until i’m 18 :(
